scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
You got a request from that little girl? The small, talktive and half-naked one over there?
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
你收到了那個小女孩的請求？就是那邊那個又小、話又多、還半裸著的那個？

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
......

[Melody-Jack]
Who the hell are you? Get out of here!
I'm only talking to base level ^FF0000121-130^000000 adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
你他媽是誰？給我滾出去！
我只和基礎等級^FF0000121-130^000000的冒險者說話。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
What? do not bother me. I am busy now.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
什麼？別煩我。我現在很忙。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
scripts.translation: [梅洛迪·傑克]

scripts.text: Say yes.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: Avoid answering.
scripts.translation: 迴避回答

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
No. I do not care It will be fine if you stepped into this room not because you are lost. I need anyone except that kind of fool.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
不。我不在乎。只要你不是迷路才走進來的，那就沒事。除了那種傻瓜，我誰都需要。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Please listen to me, I will offer you an attractive suggestion.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
請聽我說，我會給你一個誘人的提議。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I am ^ff0000Melody - Jack!^000000 The best man with best dagger skills.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
我是^ff0000梅洛迪·傑克！^000000擁有最頂尖短劍技術的男人。

scripts.text: Melody-Jack swipes a dagger in your direction.
scripts.translation: 梅洛迪·傑克朝你的方向揮了一下短劍。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I am qualified to take secret missions. And right now you're in luck.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
我有資格接受秘密任務。而且你現在運氣不錯。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
It seems that I have to lose one mission, deal and promise, I can not take it right now.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
看來我不得不放棄一個任務、一筆交易和一個承諾，我現在無法接受它。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Take my mission and solve the request of Aigu. I will compensate you.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
接受我的任務，解決艾古的請求。我會補償你。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Our deal will be kept as a secret to Aigu. If you do not have 9 lives. Lets start.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
我們的交易對艾古保密。如果你沒有九條命的話。讓我們開始吧。

scripts.text: Show me the requests!
scripts.translation: 給我看看請求！

scripts.text: Make small-talk.
scripts.translation: 閒聊

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
What? Are you interested in me?
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
什麼？你對我感興趣？

scripts.text: I am interested.
scripts.translation: 我感興趣

scripts.text: About requests
scripts.translation: 關於請求

scripts.text: About a deal
scripts.translation: 關於交易

scripts.text: What is a promise?
scripts.translation: 什麼是承諾？

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Well go away. I have no interest in you.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
哼，滾開吧。我可沒興趣理你。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I cannot stop it because of my bad credit. It drives me crazy.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
因為我的信用不好，所以我停不下來。這讓我發瘋。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
To be honest I don't think there is anyone worthy of trust. Trust or promises are both silly.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
說實話，我覺得沒有誰值得信任。信任和承諾都是愚蠢的東西。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Who're all of these kids?
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
這些都是哪來的小鬼？

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
[Melody-Jack]
I do not like it but a deal is a deal. Please come back after clearing monsters in the places where Aigu asked to search.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
雖然我不喜歡，但契約就是契約。請在艾古要求搜尋的地方清理完魔物後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
[Melody-Jack]
You finished helping Aigu or did you quit? Anyways I have no more business for you.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
你是完成了幫助艾古的任務，還是放棄了？總之，我沒有更多事要交給你了。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
[Melody-Jack]
Oh, I made a mistake. You are not the level of adventurer I am looking for. I'm looking for base level 121 to 130 adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
哦，我搞錯了。你不是我尋找的那種等級的冒險者。我在找基礎等級121到130的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I am lucky to make a double contract with an adventurer like you. They are not included in our contract.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
能和你這樣的冒險者達成雙重契約，是我的榮幸。他們不在我們的契約範圍內。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I trust only me and my deal. Trust or promises are empty if they ar broken but if a deal is broken there is compensation or revenge.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
我只信任我自己和我的交易。如果信任或承諾被打破，那就毫無意義；但如果交易被打破，會有賠償或復仇。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I came out for nothing but I am supposed to fulfill my duty. I don't owe anyone a thing.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
我出來一趟什麼也沒得到，但我必須履行我的職責。我不欠任何人任何東西。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I do not like it but a deal is a deal. Please come back after clearing monsters in the places where Aigu asked to search.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
雖然我不喜歡，但契約就是契約。請在艾古要求搜尋的地方清理完魔物後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
You finished helping Aigu or did you quit? Anyways I have no more business for you.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
你是完成了幫助艾古的任務，還是放棄了？總之，我沒有更多事要交給你了。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Oh, I made a mistake. You are not the level of adventurer I am looking for. I'm looking for base level 121 to 130 adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
哦，我搞錯了。你不是我尋找的那種等級的冒險者。我在找基礎等級121到130的冒險者。

scripts.text: Thanatos Tower related
scripts.translation: 達納托斯塔相關

scripts.text: Rachel Shrine related
scripts.translation: 拉赫神龕相關

scripts.text: Nameless Island related
scripts.translation: 無名島相關

scripts.text: Abyss Lake related
scripts.translation: 深淵湖相關

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Thanatos tower is the most annoying place. Do not worry about your compensation. I keep my word.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
達納托斯塔是最令人討厭的地方。別擔心你的賠償，我說話算話。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Aigu's adventure leads to Rachel Shrine. Okay... It is not strange if ^FF0000that human^000000 Aigu looking for is found anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
艾古的冒險指向拉赫神龕。好吧...如果艾古尋找的^FF0000那個人類^000000出現在任何地方，也不奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Nameless Island is not known to usual adventurers. Aigu is also interested in there.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
無名島不為普通冒險者所知。艾古也對那裡很感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Abyss Lake has requests from a little girl. Very dilligent.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
深淵湖有一個小女孩的請求。非常勤勉。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
scripts.translation: [梅洛迪·傑克]

scripts.text: Baroness of Retribution
scripts.translation: 代行刑者

scripts.text: Lady Solace
scripts.translation: 慰勞者

scripts.text: Mistress of Shelter
scripts.translation: 安息者

scripts.text: Dame of Sentinel
scripts.translation: 監視者

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I do not like that creature not because Aigu doesn't like them... How dare you? Who is punishing whom?
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
我不喜歡那種生物，不是因為艾古不喜歡它們... 你們怎麼敢？到底是誰在懲罰誰？

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Did you clear them? So that does not bother that little boy for a day. Good job.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
你清理掉它們了嗎？這樣那個小男孩就能安睡一天了。幹得好。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
As you know, Thanatos Tower is where Aigu cares the most. It is the most dangerous place in some ways.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
如你所知，達納托斯塔是艾古最關心的地方。在某些方面，它也是最危險的地方。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I think I finished today's performance. I cannot relax what if monsters show up suddenly.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
我想今天的演出結束了。我不能放鬆，萬一魔物突然出現怎麼辦。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
The building does not seem to be designed by human beings and a strange melody is always playing there.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
這座建築似乎不是人類設計的，而且那裡總是播放著奇怪的旋律。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Have you ever heard the melody they are playing? You will have a chance if that little boy begins to play the performance again.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
你聽過他們演奏的旋律嗎？如果那個小男孩開始再次演奏，你就有機會聽到了。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Beautiful melody. Maybe it sounds beautiful because creatures are playing.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
美麗的旋律。也許聽起來很美，是因為是生物在演奏。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I think I finished today's performance. I can not relax... What if monsters show up suddenly?
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
我想今天的演出結束了。我不能放鬆... 萬一魔物突然出現怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Do you know an angel that turned into a monster? I do not know if it was an angel or not. But its appearance was an angel.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
你知道變成魔物的天使嗎？我不知道它是不是天使。但它的外表是天使。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Good. Let me know if someone is looking for me. If so, I might need to change the details of the deal.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
好的。如果有人找我，請告訴我。如果是這樣，我可能需要更改交易的細節。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
You may have felt they are watching once you stepped into the upper area of Thanatos Tower.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
當你踏入達納托斯塔的上層區域時，你可能感覺到它們在注視著你。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
You look fine. Maybe you are better than I thought? I did not check with my eyes though.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
你看起來不錯。也許你比我想像的更好？雖然我沒有親眼確認過。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
You will meet them if Aigu requests. The Dame of Sentinels.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
如果艾古請求，你會見到她們。監視者。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I finished my performance for today. I can not relax what if monsters show up suddenly.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
我結束了今天的演出。我不能放鬆，萬一魔物突然出現怎麼辦。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Aigu's adventure leads to Rachel Shrine. Okay... It is not strange if ^FF0000that human^000000 Aigu looking for is found anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
艾古的冒險指向拉赫神龕。好吧...如果艾古尋找的^FF0000那個人類^000000出現在任何地方，也不奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
These are some of the most dangerous creatures in the world. These creatures deserve no justice.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
這些是世界上最危險的生物之一。它們不值得任何公正。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Of course you can trust me. Because I believe in real deals. Lets sweep the creatures away.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
當然你可以信任我。因為我相信真正的交易。讓我們把這些生物清掃乾淨。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Please clear monsters to help Aigu. Amateurs will make things messy.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
請清理魔物來幫助艾古。業餘人士只會把事情搞得一團糟。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
There must be a lot of them. Do not forget to keep this a secret.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
它們一定有很多。別忘了保守這個秘密。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Do not fall into the mood of the melody because that can be your last song you hear.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
不要沉浸在旋律的氛圍中，因為那可能是你聽到的最後一首歌。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Remember, there is strange music as sharp as knife to kill people in the world.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
記住，世界上有像刀一樣鋒利、能致人於死地的詭異音樂。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
However that is another obstacle. A deal is prior to personal interest anytime. So clear Lady Solace.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
不過那是另一個障礙。交易永遠優先於個人利益。所以清理慰勞者。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
We are just keeping our end of the deal. Clear those creatures now.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
我們只是在履行交易的一部分。現在清理那些生物。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Do not panic due to beautiful appearances regardless if it is an angel or a creature. You should do your job.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
無論它是天使還是生物，都不要被美麗的外表迷惑。你應該做好你的工作。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Everything has its time. Maybe you requested this because that time has come.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
萬事皆有定時。也許你提出這個請求，是因為時候到了。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I don't care if it is a real angel or just a creature. Clear Mistress of Shelter.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
我不在乎它是真正的天使還是生物。清理安息者。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Dying flowers fall down by rain and wind. That is what you have to do.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
凋零的花朵在風雨中落下。這就是你要做的。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Dame of Sentinel is not easy to handle so be sure to be ready to fight.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
監視者不容易對付，所以務必做好戰鬥準備。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
It is a fine day to die. It will be you or them so do your best.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
今天是死亡的好日子。要麼是你死，要麼是它們死，所以盡力吧。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I wish they are cleared as well for her to request this adventure easily.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
我希望它們也被清理乾淨，這樣她才能輕鬆請求這次冒險。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
A request for a request... Whatever.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
為了請求而請求...算了。

scripts.text: Vanberk and Isilla
scripts.translation: 凡貝爾克和依斯拉

scripts.text: Hodremlin
scripts.translation: 邪惡妖精

scripts.text: Agav and Echio
scripts.translation: 阿加波和艾基奧

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Someone who believes they are right are the most dangerous. This world is full of fools.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
那些自認為正確的人是最危險的。這個世界充滿了傻瓜。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Just a day. Will be fine.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
就一天而已。應該沒事的。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Sanctuary in Rachel is prohibited to normal people from entering. You gotta know that.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
拉赫的光耀之堂禁止普通人進入。這一點你必須清楚。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
You may take a rest for a day. You cleared enough but fanatic is increased.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
你可以休息一天。雖然你已經清理得夠多了，但狂信徒的數量在增加。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Cold teeth might be approaching. Its teeth are faster than your hands.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
冷牙可能正在逼近。它的牙齒比你的手更快。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I am not that worried but are you safe? Not bitten?
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
我倒是不太擔心，但你安全嗎？沒有被咬到吧？

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Fanatics are a problem. A more serious problem is that they show up suddenly.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
狂信徒是個麻煩。更嚴重的問題是，它們會突然現身。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Unknown mosters are dangerous so clear them first. I will inform you if something happens.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
未知的魔物很危險，所以先清理掉它們。如果發生什麼事，我會通知你。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Full of madness here. I just feel disgusting.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
這裡充滿了瘋狂。我只覺得噁心。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Found anyone? I wouldn't worry. A promise ia a promise and a deal is a deal.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
找到人了嗎？我不擔心。承諾就是承諾，交易就是交易。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
It is true that it is getting more dangerous inside of Rachel sanctuary, but Aigu will not care for things we are not sure.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
確實，拉赫光耀之堂內部越來越危險了，但艾古不會在意那些我們不確定的事情。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
If you can talk. There are no requests right now. Take a rest for the day.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
如果你能說話的話。現在沒有委託。休息一天吧。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Nameless Island is not known to usual adventurers. Aigu is also interested in there.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
無名島不為普通冒險者所知。艾古也對那裡很感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Finally force others to believe what they believe. Lets clear Vanberk and Isilla.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
終於強迫別人相信他們的信念了。讓我們清理凡貝爾克和依斯拉吧。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
It is not my business. But this time is different. A little boy might be in a danger so lets hurry to clear these monsters.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
這本來不是我的事。但這次不一樣。一個小男孩可能有危險，所以讓我們快點清理這些魔物。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
They think they can find a clue there but it is not a safe place. You should clear Vanberk and Isilla in advance.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
他們以為能在那裡找到線索，但那裡並不安全。你應該提前清理凡貝爾克和依斯拉。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Clear all as quickly as you can.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
儘可能快地清理所有魔物。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Rachel sanctuary will be approaching from everywhere. You should be careful of this one.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
拉赫光耀之堂將從四面八方逼近。你應該小心這個。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Just think of the job at hand. That will be enough.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
只想著手頭的工作就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Get rid of ^FF0000Hodremlin^000000 without any hesitation. Because they are very dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
毫不猶豫地消滅^FF0000邪惡妖精^000000。因為它們非常危險。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
They need faster hands than a head. I do not worry but you should be careful.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
它們需要比頭腦更快的雙手。我不擔心，但你應該小心。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
It is my feeling but you might like it. I am sure ^FF0000Agav^000000 and ^FF0000Echio^000000 will not like you.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
這是我的感覺，但你可能喜歡。我確信^FF0000阿加波^000000和^FF0000艾基奧^000000不會喜歡你。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
They will run into you. Do not hesitate and keep focused on the job.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
它們會衝向你。不要猶豫，專注於任務。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
That was not that bad. But someone needs to help? Lets clear ^FF0000Agav^000000 and ^FF0000Echio^000000 inside of Rachel Shrine.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
情況沒那麼糟。但有人需要幫助嗎？讓我們清理掉拉赫神龕裡的^FF0000阿加波^000000和^FF0000艾基奧^000000。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I cannot leave so farewell.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
我無法離開，再見。

scripts.text: Ragged Zombie Hunting
scripts.translation: 變異殭屍狩獵

scripts.text: Zombie Slaughter Hunting
scripts.translation: 殭屍屠戮者狩獵

scripts.text: Banshee Hunting
scripts.translation: 女妖狩獵

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
It is easy to meet everything on Nameless Island. So boring.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
在無名島上很容易遇到各種東西。真無聊。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Did you take a bath? It smells in here. But I am sure that you had a hard time with the smell.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
你洗澡了嗎？這裡味道好重。但我相信你在忍受這種氣味時一定很艱難。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
The dead come back at night. Comes back sounds strange. Lets cut the crap.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
死者會在夜晚歸來。“歸來”聽起來很奇怪。別廢話了。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Ragged Zombie is reduced. It is a good time to proceed Aigu's request for a minute.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
變異殭屍減少了。現在是處理艾古委託的好時機。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
It was not easy for me either to step into Nameless Island. I am not that patient.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
對我來說，踏入無名島也不容易。我沒有那麼多耐心。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
You are quite good! You cleared them. It will take time to return.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
你做得很好！你清理了它們。返回需要一些時間。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
They are dangerous unlike Ragged Zombie because they swing something sharp.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
它們揮舞著鋒利的東西，比變異殭屍更危險。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I know the request to Nameless Island is not easy but I will be happy if you join again.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
我知道去無名島的委託不容易，但如果你能再次加入，我會很高興。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
You will see there are unwelcoming things while adventuring sometimes regardless of monsters and companions.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
在冒險中，無論是否有魔物和同伴，你有時都會遇到不受歡迎的事情。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
You must be tired. You went to that tough place beyond your capability. Do not be angry. I will reward you for that.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
你一定累了。你去了那個超出你能力範圍的艱難地方。別生氣。我會獎勵你的。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Please clear ^FF0000Banshee^000000 inside of Nameless Island. Do not say no. You know it is for Aigu as well.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
請清理掉無名島裡的^FF0000女妖^000000。不要拒絕。你知道這也是為了艾古。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Banshee is cleared. Request is solved anyway but it is not the end. It will be required again sooner or later.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
女妖已清理。委託雖然解決了，但這不是結束。遲早還會需要再次處理。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Abyss Lake has requests from a little girl. Very dilligent.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
深淵湖有一個小女孩的請求。非常勤勉。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Get rid of it and help Aigu and the other adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
消滅它們，幫助艾古和其他冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Wish to clear ^FF0000Ragged Zombie^000000. It is easy because they show up everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
希望清理^FF0000變異殭屍^000000。這很容易，因為它們隨處可見。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Take a ^FF0000bath^000000 and you won't smell anymore.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
洗個^FF0000澡^000000，你就不會那麼臭了。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
But adventurers should challenge once. ^FF0000Zombie Slaughter^000000 is worth clearing.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
但冒險者應該挑戰一次。^FF0000殭屍屠戮者^000000值得清理。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Please clear ^FF0000Zombie Slaughter^000000. Be careful to avoid their blades.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
請清理^FF0000殭屍屠戮者^000000。小心避開它們的刀刃。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
You've got many things to take care of so I will hold my words. Clear them.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
你有很多事情要處理，我就不多說了。去清理它們吧。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
This request is like that for me. I just do not like creatures or the reason of giving this request.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
這個委託對我來說也是如此。我只是不喜歡那些生物，或者說是釋出這個委託的原因。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Both Banshee and Aigu are annoying. I would not do this request but you will be different. Right?
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
女妖和艾古都很煩人。我不會做這個委託，但你會不一樣。對吧？

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
See? Someone needs this request. Clear ^FF0000Banshees^000000 at Nameless Island.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
看吧？有人需要這個委託。去清理無名島上的^FF0000女妖^000000。

scripts.text: Ferus and Bewler are cleared.
scripts.translation: 紅貝勒斯和貝勒已清理

scripts.text: Gold and Blue Acidus are cleared.
scripts.translation: 金色和藍色灰俄希托斯已清理

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Abyss Lake... Do you possibly know how to get in there? You are not an adventurer with that information?
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
深淵湖...你知道怎麼進去嗎？你不是擁有這種資訊的冒險者嗎？

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Did you clear all of the dragons? Take a rest for a day.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
你清理完所有的龍了嗎？休息一天吧。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Abyss Lake is full of dragons in and out. Dragons are not that special but there are so many.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
深淵湖內外到處都是龍。龍本身並不特別，但數量太多了。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Green dragons and Red dragons remind me of watermelons.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
綠龍和紅龍讓我想起西瓜。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Just in case I will give you a clue that a key and an entrance are going to be found around there.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
以防萬一，我告訴你一個線索：鑰匙和入口會在附近找到。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Which one is more dangerous between Ferus and Bewler? I do not know. Clear both of them.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
紅貝勒斯和貝勒哪個更危險？我不知道。把兩個都清理掉。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Neither green nor red are disturbing. But regardless, come back after clearing all.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
無論是綠色還是紅色，都很煩人。但無論如何，清理完所有後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Abyss Lake is not close. But it is worth visiting.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
深淵湖並不近。但值得一去。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
You are more of a talented adventurer than I thought. If you found a tactic, take care of it next time. This study is up to you.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
你比我想像的更有天賦。如果你找到了策略，下次就處理它。這個研究由你決定。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
There is a cave where dragons are living inside of Abyss Lake. There are so many but flying things are annoying.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
深淵湖裡有一個洞穴，龍住在裡面。數量很多，但飛行生物很煩人。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Take a rest. We should go and subdue Acidus dragons again.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
休息一下。我們應該再去制服灰俄希托斯龍。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
This is technically a training exercise but just pretend you are helping someone. There will be a reward.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
這其實只是一次訓練，但你就當作是在幫人忙吧。會有獎勵的。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Subdue them as best as you can. Do not mind their colors because they are all to be cleared.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
盡你所能去制服它們。不要在意它們的顏色，因為都要清理乾淨。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Subdue the Gold and Blue Acidus monsters at the last level of Abyss Lake.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
去深淵湖的最後區域，制服金色和藍色的灰俄希托斯。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I am not sure if you found what you are looking for... I cannot be involved anymore. Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
我不確定你是否找到了你要找的東西... 我不能再參與這件事了。謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
{0} is cleared. No need to have more requests.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
{0}已經清理完畢。不需要再提出更多請求了。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
{0} is cleared. A deal is a deal. I need to get paid.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
{0}已經清理完畢。說好的就是說好的。我需要拿到報酬。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Hey there! ... Wait.?
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·傑克]
嘿，你好！... 等等？

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Hi? A fine day like today. Can I ask for a favor? I heard that adventurers in Eden Group are nice.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
嗨？今天天氣真好。能請你幫個忙嗎？我聽說樂園團的冒險者都很友善。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
It is nice to come back to Midgard! Very exciting as the first day.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
能回到米德加爾特真好！第一天感覺非常興奮。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Oh, why aren't you a part of Eden Group?
I'm only talking to base level ^FF0000121-130^000000 adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
哦，你為什麼不是樂園團的一員呢？
我只對基礎等級 ^FF0000121-130^000000 的冒險者說話。

scripts.text: [Aigu]
scripts.translation: [艾古]

scripts.text: I'm not the nice kind.
scripts.translation: 我不是那種友善的人

scripts.text: Sure, I'll help.
scripts.translation: 當然，我會幫忙

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
yek.. I hate.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
嘖... 我討厭這樣。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Really? I will introduce myself! I am the head of the ^ff0000Dandelion band Aigu.^000000
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
真的嗎？讓我自我介紹一下！我是 ^ff0000蒲公英樂隊^000000 的隊長艾古。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
I just came back from a local performance. There is someone I wanted to meet but is missing now so I came to Eden Group for a request.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
我剛從當地的演出回來。有個人我想見，但現在不在，所以我來樂園團釋出一個請求。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
I just decided to make a request by myself because no one is in charge and everyone is busy. Thanks for the help.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
因為沒人負責，大家都很忙，所以我決定自己釋出請求。謝謝你的幫助。

scripts.text: What is your request?
scripts.translation: 你的請求是什麼？

scripts.text: Talk about something else.
scripts.translation: 聊聊別的

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Dandelion band travels all around the world and conveys healing music to people
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
蒲公英樂隊周遊世界，向人們傳遞治癒的音樂

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Actually our songs have no magic but I am sure it helps people because I am singing.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
其實我們的歌並沒有魔法，但我相信它能幫助人們，因為是我在歌唱。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
I think it is difficult for you to get my request? For now, I think it will make more people lost. How about widening your sight by travelling?
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
你覺得很難完成我的請求嗎？現在，我覺得這隻會讓更多人迷失。不如去旅行，開闊一下眼界吧？

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
I made a shelter for someone I am looking for and lost adventurers. I want to know which adventurer has been there.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
我為我在尋找的人以及迷路的冒險者搭建了一個避難所。我想知道哪位冒險者去過那裡。

scripts.text: Thanatos Tower search
scripts.translation: 達納托斯塔搜尋

scripts.text: Rachel Sanctuary search
scripts.translation: 拉赫光耀之堂搜尋

scripts.text: Nameless Island search
scripts.translation: 無名島搜尋

scripts.text: Abyss Lake search
scripts.translation: 深淵湖搜尋

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
You know someone went there but you do not know who that is? Thank you. But let me ask you to search again tomorrow since we do not know who it is.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
你知道有人去過那裡，但不知道是誰？謝謝。但既然我們不知道是誰，請明天再來幫我搜索一次。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Adventurers are easily lost because of dangerous monsters and the height of thanatos tower. But it isn't impossible for some adventurers so please check for me.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
由於危險的魔物和達納托斯塔的高度，冒險者很容易迷路。但對某些冒險者來說並非不可能，請幫我查一下。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
How was your trip? No special news. But it is not done yet so I will ask you to search again.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
旅途如何？沒有特別的訊息。但事情還沒結束，我會請你再搜尋一次。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
There is a sanctuary inside of Rachel Shrine. It is possible to get stuck there once you're inside.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
拉赫神龕內部有一個光耀之堂。一旦進去，就有可能被困住。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Thank you! There are wandering adventurers also helping! We should continue to search anyway. Please help me next time again.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
謝謝！也有流浪的冒險者在幫忙！無論如何，我們應該繼續搜尋。下次請再幫我一次。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Yes, Maybe they're not able to come because they've been captured by the dead! Nameless Island will be fine! Please search Nameless Island.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
是的，也許他們因為被亡靈捕獲而無法回來。無名島應該沒問題！請搜尋無名島。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
You came back safely but I guess there was no good result for your face. I will search more so do not disappoint! Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
你安全回來了，但從你的表情看，似乎沒有好訊息。我會繼續搜尋，請不要失望！謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
I suggest to search Abyss Lake precisely the cave at the middle of the lake.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
我建議搜尋深淵湖，特別是湖中央的洞穴。

scripts.text: [Aigu]
scripts.translation: [艾古]

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
I will ask to search again after for a while because there is hope since a trace of someone was found.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
因為發現了某人的蹤跡，所以還有希望。過一會兒我會請你再搜尋一次。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
You may find shelter on top of the tower. Even that shelter only has water and a bonfire.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
你可能在塔頂找到避難所。即使那個避難所只有水和篝火。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Searching Rachel was enough. I will ask you again after a while.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
搜尋拉赫已經足夠了。過一會兒我會再請你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Not able to enter the sanctuary in a usual way. It is not easy but we can find a clue at Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
無法以通常的方式進入光耀之堂。這不容易，但我們可以在拉赫找到線索。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Searching Nameless Island will continue at another time. How about taking a rest for a while?
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
搜尋無名島將在另一次進行。不如先休息一下？

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Maybe... hanging out and drinking with the dead. But please talk with me.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
也許...和死者一起喝酒消遣吧。但請和我談談。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
I will try to search Abyss Lake again after a while.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
過一會兒我會再去深淵湖搜尋一次。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Maybe, disappointed and fallen down because a monster was not found on the ground of the lake.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
也許是因為在湖底沒有找到魔物，失望地倒下了。

scripts.text: Begin to search.
scripts.translation: 開始搜尋

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Thanatos tower is north of the Schwarzwald Republic! It is not far from Juno or Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
達納托斯塔位於修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的北方！距離朱諾或毀葛都不遠。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Please take a look if there are any traces of lost adventurers at the southeast part of the 2nd floor in the middle zone.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
請檢視中央區域2樓東南部分，看是否有失蹤冒險者的蹤跡。

scripts.text: Begin the search.
scripts.translation: 開始搜尋

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
I wish you safety in your search.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
祝你在搜尋中平安。

scripts.text: Begin the search.
scripts.translation: 開始搜尋

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
I wil ask you to search the 1st underground of the monastery on Nameless Island. I cannot make you take that risk unless you volunteer.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
我想請你搜索無名島修道院的地下1層。除非你自願，否則我不能讓你承擔這種風險。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Yes! The end of a good adventure needs a dragon! I've heard there is a monster on the ground of a lake.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
是的！一場精彩冒險的結尾需要一條龍！我聽說湖底有一隻魔物。

scripts.text: Begin the search.
scripts.translation: 開始搜尋

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Abyss Lake is the fastest way to get to Hugel. Please visit 3rd floor of underground cave.!
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
深淵湖是前往毀葛最快的路線。請去地下洞穴的3樓看看！

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
I can't give you any more search tasks right now! You need harder challenges suitable for your level.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
我現在不能再給你更多搜尋任務了！你需要適合你等級的更艱難的挑戰。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Oh, you've been working on {0} Adventure task. Let me clear your record, so you can work on better tasks.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
哦，你已經完成了{0}個冒險任務。讓我清除你的記錄，這樣你就可以接更好的任務了。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Oh, you've already finished {0} Adventure. Thank you for helping me out with this task!.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
哦，你已經完成了{0}個冒險任務。謝謝你幫我完成這個任務！

scripts.text: I found traces of someone who was here but I cannot find a clue. Lets go back and report to Aigu.
scripts.translation: 我發現了有人來過的痕跡，但找不到線索。讓我們回去向艾古報告吧。

scripts.text: There are traces of someone being here.
scripts.translation: 這裡有有人來過的痕跡。

scripts.text:
[Disguised Adventurer]
I am just working at this dangerous place for 5000 zeny... Are you the adventurer who got a request from Eden Group?
scripts.translation:
[偽裝的冒險者]
我只是在這裡這個危險的地方工作，為了5000 Zeny...你是那個接到樂園團委托的冒險者嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Disguised Adventurer]
I could see that is not you at first glance!
scripts.translation:
[偽裝的冒險者]
我一眼就看出你不是那個人了！

scripts.text:
[Disguised Adventurer]
The adventurers proceeding the request for Aigu are warped to the upper level on behalf of Aigu.
scripts.translation:
[偽裝的冒險者]
替艾古執行委託的冒險者會被傳送到上層。

scripts.text:
[Disguised Adventurer]
Or please pretend not to know me! I will be in a danger if you blow my cover!
scripts.translation:
[偽裝的冒險者]
或者請假裝不認識我！如果你揭穿我，我會陷入危險！

scripts.text: [Disguised Adventurer]
scripts.translation: [偽裝的冒險者]

scripts.text: Go up.
scripts.translation: 上去

scripts.text: Do not go up.
scripts.translation: 不上去

scripts.text:
[Disguised Adventurer]
Be careful! You can not come down once you go up. For Aigu!
scripts.translation:
[偽裝的冒險者]
小心！一旦上去就無法下來了。為了艾古！

scripts.text:
[Disguised Adventurer]
It seems that you're currently not doing the Thanatos Tower adventure request. I'm sorry but I'm doing this for Aigu and not you.
scripts.translation:
[偽裝的冒險者]
看來你目前並沒有在進行達納托斯塔的冒險委託。很抱歉，我這麼做是為了艾古，而不是為了你。
